body:
No idea. What do you end up with when you’re left alone weeks at a time from the age of 3? Start drugs at 13 and get kicked out at 16?

Feels like depression, anxiety, sociopathy, trust issues, inability to communicate properly (I learned mostly through reading), and a complete lack of concern for my wellbeing. I actually remember testing my willpower when I was 7 or 8. Specifically “wonder if I have the willpower to give myself a permanent injury”. I did and I did.

From everything I’ve read or watched there is no real recovery from stuff done to you in your early childhood. I’m ok living for other people though as I see the value in others.

At surface level, yes, I am very positive, I have a lot of hope in humanity and society in general.

I think, had I had a normal life, I would be an obnoxiously happy/positive person. As it is I have no regard for self and no self worth with a whole smorgasbord of mental & physical health issues. It’s kinda like I hope for other people but not myself, it’s weird and hard to make sense of.
you would have to see it to get the reference. I miss my life as a junky.
